title: Designing Adaptive Digital Nudging Systems with LLM-Driven Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Addressed architecturally rather than empirically measured; the system uses a 'Fairness Monitor' to inject bias mitigation system prompts into LLM calls to enforce non-discrimination and protect vulnerable users.
Evaluated through system instantiation and user facial emotion tracking to ensure adaptive nudges do not cross into manipulative, non-compliant, or overly intrusive interventions.
